description: Natural terracotta square tile, 8x8 inch, from Pak Clay, listed for outdoor use. The mid-size square suits paths, steps, verandas and small courtyards where a 12 inch tile feels too large. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour with slight shade variation between pieces. Lay it on a sound base that slopes to drain, and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer, since clay is porous. Order the full quantity from one batch with a margin for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

The 2:1 shape lets you lay brick-bond, herringbone or basket-weave patterns that add interest to kitchens, verandas and hallways. Fired clay has a warm colour with natural shade variation. Clay is porous, so ask your fixer about a breathable sealer and a suitable adhesive. Patterned layouts use more tile for cuts, so order extra from one batch.
